title: Interview Risk Debrief Workbench
oneLiner: A hiring debrief console that turns scattered interview notes into clear risk signals, contradictions, and next verification questions.
targetUser: Startup hiring managers, recruiting leads, and small-team interview panels.
keyUX: Scan one candidate, compare interviewer signal quality, isolate contradictions, and choose the next validation question before making a hire decision.
stitchPrompt: Design a desktop hiring operations dashboard called Interview Risk Debrief Workbench for startup hiring managers and team leads. It should help teams turn scattered interview notes into a clear hire/no-hire discussion by surfacing signal strength, risk clusters, conflicting feedback, and the next verification questions. Include a hiring KPI hero, a candidate debrief queue, a competency score matrix, a contradiction and risk panel, a follow-up question drawer, and a final decision summary rail. Design direction: use a dense operator-console style with graphite, soft ivory, and restrained cobalt accents; keep tables crisp, hierarchy fast to scan, and the product feel disciplined, evidence-driven, and high-trust.
